assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game environment sprite for a top-down dark fantasy shinobi dungeon. Primary request: an ANCIENT HOLE IN THE GROUND SPEWING MYSTICAL POWER. One isolated large elliptical abyss with a broken ring of weathered basalt stones, archaic carved ward glyphs, fractured concentric ritual masonry; the inside is visibly bottomless ink-black with a luminous pale lavender and blue-white rift far down inside. Wisps of supernatural energy rise softly upward from below, a few suspended fragments, restrained spectral mist. The physical hole and layered broken stone rim must be the dominant feature, not a flat magical circle or upright portal. Style: premium hand-painted game environment, detailed painterly stone, cohesive dark blue-black palette with muted old brass etchings and silvery violet magical light, polished art direction rather than a photograph. Camera: overhead three-quarter almost top-down (about 75 degrees downward), broad horizontally elliptical hole, north rear rocky lip slightly higher, no horizon. Composition: entire isolated feature centered with generous transparent margins, source hole takes about 70 percent of width, floating energy wisps extend into upper third but do not hide the rim. Grounded low structure, no tall standing rocks, no characters, no interface, no readable text, no modern objects, no border, no watermark. TRUE transparent background beyond the irregular broken rock silhouette and energy wisps. Intended to sit against a dungeon chamber's north boundary with walkable floor below it. Keep energy delicately luminous, avoid saturated neon, avoid giant bright flames, preserve abyss depth.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished overhead game-room floor painting, landscape 3:2 composition. Primary request: an ancient subterranean ritual chamber floor surrounding a source of mystical power. This is only the continuous WALKABLE FLOOR SURFACE, no walls or solid objects, no pit or hole, no doors, no characters. Premium hand-painted dark fantasy shinobi environment art, orthographic overhead camera, no horizon or perspective vanishing point. An expanse of weathered charcoal-blue basalt paving, broad irregular stone slabs, partly buried concentric ritual engravings that are subtle and asymmetrical rather than a perfectly drawn magic circle, eroded ancient symbolic inscriptions with no readable text, small hairline fissures containing very faint cool silver-violet luminescence. Sparse dust and age worn into the stone. Composition: polished cohesive surface painting with quiet unoccupied center and lower half for character movement, worn carved bands subtly concentrated near perimeter. Dark but readable, low contrast texture with carefully modeled stone contact shadows. The inscriptions and cracks carry a sense of centuries of suppressed supernatural pressure. Avoid flat repeated grids or identical tiles, avoid busy visual noise, avoid large glowing rings, avoid props, debris piles, vertical stone formations, lava, water, neon colors, cartoon outlines, photograph, interface, border, text, logos, watermark. Must fill the entire canvas edge to edge so it can paint a whole rectangular room. Use restrained slate, indigo-black, faint lavender and aged muted stone-gold.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a lightweight transparent game VFX sprite, one spectral energy plume rising from an ancient hole in the ground. Subject: a delicate vertical ribbon of pale silver-lavender supernatural mist, flowing upward from a small bright base at the lower center, curling into a few irregular translucent folds and dissolving at the top. A subtle blue-white luminous inner thread, soft violet edges, two or three tiny suspended sparks. Premium hand-painted dark fantasy game art; restrained and eerie, fine soft detail, actual partially transparent vapor edges. Narrow plume in the center with generous truly transparent margins on every side; portrait composition. Only the energy, no hole, stones, floor, ground shadow, background, characters, faces, wings, symbols, text, UI, border or watermark. The lowest point is the emission source, the stream rises above it, with an elegant taper and asymmetric drifting shape. Avoid roaring fire, thick smoke, opaque neon, large bright blobs, symmetrical swirls, photographed smoke, abstract full-canvas graphics. It will be layered over a dark carved-stone abyss and animated by drifting the entire sprite upward while fading. Keep the overall luminosity subtle enough for repeated layered wisps, with a readable slim rising form and real alpha transparency.

notes: Whole-room painting, discovered solid-stone breach anchors, bounded camera framing, painted energy sprites and rising motes. Animations use opacity/transform on independent HTML layers and are culled to the camera window; the terrain SVG remains static. The sprite silhouette may project onto the dark backdrop but never reveals underlying unknown terrain. Geometry, collision, encounters and rewards remain authoritative. WebP assets retain the generated alpha where present.
